author: raymond91125
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete 
GO:0001054 RNA polymerase I activity
GO:0001055 RNA polymerase II activity
GO:0001056 RNA polymerase III activity
GO:0001057 RNA polymerase IV activity
GO:0001058 RNA polymerase V activity
GO:0001064 single subunit type RNA polymerase activity
GO:0001065 mitochondrial single subunit type RNA polymerase activity

Annotations to the polymerase terms may be moved to GO:0003899 DNA-directed 5'-3' RNA polymerase activity.
Regulation terms are MFs.

see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/23779

author: srengel
body: There are distinct types of RNA polymerases (Pol I, II, and III) that differ in their subunit composition and the specific types of RNA they transcribe, with Pol I making ribosomal RNA, Pol II transcribing messenger RNA, and Pol III producing transfer RNA and small ribosomal RNAs; essentially, each polymerase has a specialized function based on the genes it targets.
